topSignals.title: Topsoe crosses the two-month mark with no SOFC/SOEC news; Elcogen reaches five weeks quiet.
topSignals.text: Direct fetch of both priority-stack newsrooms today confirms no solid-oxide-specific release since Topsoe's Aug 27 H1 2026 results/SOEC pathway reset (60 days) and Elcogen's Sept 21 Metrosert testing-cooperation item (35 days). Topsoe's press-releases page remains dominated by SAF/ammonia/e-methanol contracts (most recently the Oct 14 Bharat Petroleum Mumbai deal); Elcogen's news archive is still topped by the Metrosert item. A genuinely quiet comprehensive sweep across all three tiers, the AI-datacenter deployment pipeline, regulation, competing power, and the benchmark register today — no new item surfaced anywhere, so the competitive landscape and the benchmark register (SOFC_Benchmark_Records.md) are unchanged from yesterday. Elcogen News | Topsoe press releases

items.text: Elcogen (priority): No new news-archive item since Sept 21 (Metrosert cooperation), confirmed by direct fetch today — 35 days quiet. Status unchanged: elcoStack E3000 G2 platform (75% FC electrical efficiency / 90% with heat recovery, 33 kWh/kg H2 SOEC — vendor claims) in volume production at the 360 MW/yr ELCO I Tallinn factory.

Topsoe (priority): No new solid-oxide-specific release since Aug 27 (H1 2026 results/SOEC pathway reset), confirmed by direct fetch today — 60 days quiet, crossing the two-month mark; topsoe.com/press-releases remains dominated by SAF/ammonia/e-methanol contract news (most recently the Oct 14 Bharat Petroleum Mumbai SAF deal), out of SOFC/SOEC scope.

Today's Tier 2 dedicated rotation slot (Bloom Energy, Ceres Power): no new stack/cell-technology items for either. Bloom Energy results repeated its Q3 FY2026 earnings release (already logged Oct 23) and standing data-center deal background; Ceres Power results were the standing AGM 2026 CEO slides and enkiai.com aggregator recaps, no new primary disclosure.

Tier 2 sweep — "Bloom Energy OR FuelCell Energy OR Ceres Power OR Sunfire OR SolydEra": no new item; one notable false positive checked and ruled out — a Cummins/Ceres "DOE fuel cell deal" headline (datacenterdynamics.com) re-verified as a 2016 story, same recurring false positive as earlier in this monitor.

Today's Tier 3 dedicated rotation — cycle round 3 (Plansee, Huatsing Power, Ningbo SOFCMAN, Chaozhou Three-Circle/CCTC, Delta Electronics, Shell), 7-day lookback: no new items for any of the six. Plansee results were powder-metallurgy interconnect background pages, no 2026 news; Huatsing Power and Ningbo SOFCMAN results were academic/patent background only; Chaozhou Three-Circle (CCTC) again returned no company-specific SOFC/SOEC news (fourth dedicated search in this monitor with no result — this remains an open data gap); Delta Electronics results repeated the standing 2024 Ceres-Delta hydrogen-license deal; Shell results were maritime-SOFC background (Doosan/KSOE MoU, confirmed old) and enkiai.com aggregator pieces.

Tier 3 sweep — "Reverion OR Convion OR Hexis OR Doosan Fuel Cell OR SK ecoplant": no new item; results were the standing Sept 18 Doosan-Reverion $78M/£60M SOFC stack-supply order and the Sept 29 Reverion EUR150M Series B, both already on file.
Competitor roster: SOFC systems for data centers

Bloom Energy: Deployed/signed at multiple named sites - Oracle/Project Jupiter (NM, installation underway), AEP (1 GW), Brookfield EaaS, Nebius (328 MW, Finland), Equinix (>100 MW/19 sites), Aligned "Project Phoenix" (2 GW, PA), Hitachi (Japan), SK Eternix (Icheon/Paju, Korea, 28 MW, operational).

FuelCell Energy (incl. HyAxiom-branded products): Signed orders/PPAs - Fit Energy (up to 380 MW), Inuverse Korea (up to 100 MW), 75 MW Texas Capacity Reservation Agreement, SDCL (up to 450 MW). No named deployment live yet.

Doosan Fuel Cell/HyAxiom: Signed order - US AI data center supply contract (KRW 823.6B cumulative, mixed SOFC/PAFC); separately supplies SOFC stacks to Reverion. No named data-center site of its own yet.
Convion: Pipeline-only/pre-commercial under HD Hyundai ownership; no named data-center customer.
SK ecoplant: Pipeline-only (2023-vintage GDS Singapore SOFC deal); no new named data-center deployment.
Ceres Power's SOFC licensees (Doosan, Delta Electronics, Weichai): Licensing/pipeline-only; no named data-center deployment via Ceres licensing directly.
Reverion: Pipeline-only - Doosan-supplied SOFC stacks for rSOC power plants (Germany); no named data-center customer yet.
Petra Power: Pre-commercial, no named customer; first infrastructure deployment targeted 2028.
